questions: Known for scoring Iron Man and Pacific Rim, this Iranian-German composer won two Emmy Awards for his work on a fantasy HBO series — who is he?
Ramin Djawadi (born 19 July 1974) is an Iranian-German film score composer, conductor, and record producer.

This Beninese-American actor earned Oscar nominations for In America and Blood Diamond, after breaking through as Cinqué in a Spielberg historical drama, and later played Korath in the Marvel Cinematic Universe — who is he?

Asimov's short stories from Astounding Science Fiction and Super Science Stories were fixed up into this single 1950 collection, initially printed in just 5,000 copies — which book?
